title: Threads for AIP-1, AIP-2, AIP-4 and AIP-5
quote: AIP-4 runs in its own thread, and AIP-1, AIP-2 and AIP-5 should each have their own thread too.
means: AIP-1 (build), AIP-2 (build), AIP-4 (Understand) and AIP-5 (Understand) each get a thread of their own, as AIP-3 has. AIP-6 gets its own when it continues.
